name: LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme

clauses.text: The applicant should be a citizen of India.
The applicant should be a Roadside Cobbler identified by the Gram Panchayat.
The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
The applicant should be in the 18 to 50 years age group.
The applicant should be from Charmakar Community only (Dhor, Chambhar, Holar, Mochi, etc.).
The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than or equal to ₹1,00,000/-.
The applicant should have knowledge of the business for which he has applied for the loan.

documents_required: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Marksheet of Class 10th/12th, etc)
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of the State of Maharashtra.
Proof of being a Roadside Cobbler (issued by the Gram Panchayat),
Income Certificate issued by an Authorised Govt.Officer.
Caste Certificate issued by an Authorised Govt.Officer.
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc).
Any other document required by the District Office of LIDCOM.
